All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
BaseFileProcessor
The BaseFileProcessor interface defines the operations required to process media files.
Constants
The Constants class defines a collection of static constants used throughout the Musify application.
FileHandler
The FileHandler class provides utility methods for reading from and writing to files.
InvalidFormatException
The InvalidFormatException indicates that an error has occurred due to invalid data or file format.
InvalidLineException
InvalidLineException indicates that a line of data or input contains an error, typically due to invalid format or missing information.
ListOfPlaylists
The ListOfPlaylists class contains a collection of Playlist objects.
Media
The Media class is an abstract representation of various types of media such as songs, podcasts, or short clips.
MediaNotFoundException
MediaNotFoundException indicates that a requested media file or media content (such as captions, lyrics, or a media resource) cannot be found.
MediaType
The MediaType enum represents the types of media that can be used in the system: SONG, PODCAST, and SHORTCLIP.
Messages
The Messages class serves as a centralized repository for predefined string messages used throughout the Musify application.
MusifyApp
The MusifyApp class is the entry of application, which allows user to manipulate its playlist.
Playable
The Playable interface defines the method for media items that can be played.
Playlist<T>
Represents a playlist that can store one of types of media.It leverages generics to manage different media types and provides functions for adding, removing, viewing, and playing media items.
PlaylistFullException
PlaylistFullException is thrown when an attempt is made to add more media to a playlist that has reached its capacity.
Podcast
The Podcast class represents a specific type of media.
PodcastCategory
The PodcastCategory enum represents various categories for podcasts, such as EDUCATION, HEALTH, TECHNOLOGY, COMEDY, and NEWS.
PodcastFileProcessor
The PodcastFileProcessor class is responsible for processing and validating podcast media files.
ShortClip
The ShortClip class represents a type of media.
ShortClipFileProcessor
The ShortClipFileProcessor class is responsible for processing and validating short clip media files.
Song
The Song class represents a type of media for songs.
SongFileProcessor
The SongFileProcessor class is responsible for processing and validating song media files.
SongGenre
The SongGenre enum represents various genres of songs, such as JAZZ, POP, ROCK, CLASSICAL, HIP_HOP, and ELECTRONIC.
Storable
The Storable interface defines methods for objects to be loaded and written back to the original file.
